wavlm_evaluation.sampling: Deduplicate exact bytes, shuffle by fixed seed per class, then cap; source/speaker independence requires external verification.

condition_definitions.telephone_band_8khz: 300 Hz high-pass, 3400 Hz low-pass, FFmpeg 8 kHz then 16 kHz resampling; not a complete telephone codec/channel
condition_definitions.noise_15db: Seeded Gaussian noise at nominal 15 dB SNR then clipping
condition_definitions.mp3_64kbps: 64 kbps MP3 encode/decode; stream delay/padding can change duration

selective_metrics.undefined_policy: Precision is zero when no positive prediction; recall/F1/FPR are null for absent reference classes.

roc_eer.eer_method: Linear interpolation on empirical ROC; not a deployment threshold selected on test data.

forced_binary_0_5.undefined_policy: Precision is zero when no positive prediction; recall/F1/FPR are null for absent reference classes.

clean.forced_binary_note: Uses scored recordings only; differs from the app's abstaining 0.35/0.65 policy.

summary.warning: Scored coverage within audio differs from recording-level decision coverage. Overlapping windows are not independent examples.

limitations: Scripted cases are diagnostic examples, not an independent real-call benchmark.
This audit identifies model files but cannot prove train/test separation or selected training epoch.
No accuracy claim is supported by scores/confidence alone.
Request/inference timings exclude the browser workflow; app end-to-end latency is not measured.
Explanation fidelity needs human review. The keyword baseline is a documented comparator, not an established commercial tool.
